subject.title: Palo Alto Unified School District Board

text: Math Support Teacher, PTA Leader, Board Member, Mom

As a Palo Alto Unified School District teacher and mom, I believe in the potential of every child. I earned my Master of Science in Elementary and Special Education, and found my calling helping students develop their math skills. That strong foundation gives them the confidence they need to thrive. I want to bring my leadership to the PAUSD Board to help all students thrive by providing an excellent education for every student, nurturing an environment where all students matter and belong, and rebuilding trust across the district and within the community.

All students deserve excellence, which includes critical thinking, problem solving, leadership and teamwork skills that prepare them to embrace their futures. When students discover their passions, they find strong motivation to go deep into subjects they love. I will advocate for students to develop these skills and pursue their passions in AP, Honors, Advanced, College Prep, Vocational and Elective classes.

Students who know they matter and belong become happy, confident, resilient, and willing to share their unique perspectives. I will work to create a culture of belonging, where every student is truly seen and valued.

Trust allows teachers, staff, and families to bring their knowledge and expertise to solve problems together and deliver excellence. I will rebuild trust by listening respectfully; following fair, consistent, and transparent processes; and clearly explaining my votes.

My family is deeply invested in PAUSD, with one graduate and one current student. As an award-winning PTA leader, I've created programs, developed relationships, and advocated for every child because that's how strong schools are built.

Beyond our public schools, I helped restart TrackWatch, a local suicide prevention group, so that community members can learn how to provide care and support to our vulnerable young people. My service on several executive boards gives me experience managing people and budgets.

As a school board trustee, I will bring my classroom experiences, governance skills, and steadfast belief in the potential of every child to advocate for all students. Students will be at the center of every vote I cast.

Please join over 100 community leaders in supporting my campaign.
I would be grateful for your vote. Find out more at LindaHenigin.com.

text: Research Scientist

Over my many years in Palo Alto, I've often asked people why they moved here. Practically everyone gives the same answer: our excellent public schools. Even as an East Bay high school student, I admired the reputation of Paly and Gunn and thought that if I ever had children, I would want them to grow up here.

As luck would have it, I came to Stanford, where I earned four degrees in mathematics and electrical engineering, culminating in a PhD in electrical engineering. Along the way, a Fulbright scholarship took me to Germany, where I met my wife, Katja. I stayed in Palo Alto, built my career here, and when it came time to raise our family, Palo Alto was the obvious choice.

I am the son of Taiwanese immigrants, while Katja brings French and German heritage to our family. We value Palo Alto's remarkable mix of backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives. Our three children attended Ohlone, JLS Connections, and Paly, and we experienced firsthand much of what makes this district extraordinary.

As an engineer, inventor, and co-founder of Shazam, I built my career turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually work. That requires hard data, deep research, creative collaboration, persistence, and the humility to listen. I want to bring that same grounded problem-solving to our School Board.

Our district has been through a turbulent period. Too often, families have felt treated as adversaries, educators have felt unheard, academic opportunities have been reduced, and disagreements have escalated into costly legal battles. We need a genuine cultural reset based on trust, transparency, empathy, and collaboration.

Academic excellence and equity should reinforce each other. Every student deserves an education that recognizes individual strengths, needs, interests, and aspirations. We should provide strong foundations, appropriate support, and meaningful opportunities for every student to grow and thrive. Raising the floor should never require lowering the ceiling.

Our policies should follow credible evidence and honest measures of student learning—not ideology or educational fashion. We must also be responsible stewards of public funds: prioritizing classrooms and competitive educator pay, scrutinizing spending, and replacing costly legal confrontation with earlier, collaborative problem-solving.

I don't pretend to have every answer. I will listen with humility, ask hard questions, follow the evidence, and work to restore the excellence, trust, and partnership our community expects from its schools.
I hope to earn your vote!
VoteAveryWang.com

text: Vice President of Forward Deployed Engineering
For more detail, visit www.votejohncraig.com.

My wife, Jenny, and I are public school graduates, and today we're raising a 7th grader in Palo Alto's public schools. I am running because every student deserves an exceptional education and every family deserves a district that is accountable and transparent to families at every level. I come from a family of educators, judges, and journalists who taught me the value of learning, integrity, asking difficult questions, and taking action. The elected Board must rebuild trust through action and accountability.

When my family and others saw that the current system could be substantially improved, I did not stand by. I spoke up, helped organize families, and got more involved. I challenged opaque superintendent separation agreements totaling more than $1 million and successfully advocated to preserve teaching assistants and drama education, support sexual harassment survivors, and provide advanced courses. I have seen how much our students accomplish and how much more they could if parents, students, teachers, and administrators collaborate more effectively. We need to improve the culture in Palo Alto schools, and I'm ready to do the hard work to make that happen.

My career has centered on leading multinational and multicultural teams through complex change. As an operations-focused executive, I have scaled organizations, launched startups, and worked with businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies. I have learned to listen to different perspectives, manage resources transparently and responsibly, and turn ambitious goals into measured results.
On the Board, I will focus on four priorities.
Transparent and collaborative governance: rigorous, independent Board oversight, direct channels for public input, and accountability for every decision and dollar.

Comprehensive academic excellence: supporting and challenging every student according to their abilities, interests, and needs while offering broad options across the arts, athletics, career education, and enrichment.
Mental health and safety: thoughtful coordination among schools, families, local and state agencies, and our broader community.
Practical technology: preparing students to use powerful new tools effectively and responsibly, requiring evidence before adoption, and evaluating results after implementation.

I offer independent judgment, results-oriented executive discipline, a parent's perspective, and a willingness to speak up and solve difficult problems. Together, we can build schools that deliver for every student and earn our community's confidence. Your vote is a sacred trust, and I would be honored to uphold it.
